checkout.stripeNote: You will enter your card details on Stripe's secure checkout page. RouteFlow never stores your card data.
checkout.stripeNotConfigured: Payments are not configured yet. Add STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (and STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET) to your environment to accept real payments.
checkout.errorGeneric: We could not start the payment. Please try again.
checkout.cancelledBody: Your payment was not completed, so no charge was made. You can try again below.
checkout.success.pendingBody: Stripe received your payment and the confirmation is on its way. This page updates automatically.
checkout.success.pendingHint: You do not need to pay again. We will refresh in a few seconds.
checkout.success.paidBody: Your payment is confirmed. Keep this receipt to track your delivery.
checkout.success.escrowBody: The amount of your purchase is protected in a secure escrow account. It will not be released to the seller until you confirm you received the product.
checkout.success.sellerBody: The seller has been notified of your purchase and has instructions to ship the product with tracking.
checkout.success.confirmBody: Once you receive your product you will be asked to confirm delivery. Only then will the funds be released to the seller.
checkout.success.next1: Wait for the seller to send your tracking number
checkout.success.next2: Receive your product and check it is in good condition
checkout.success.next3: Confirm delivery to release the funds to the seller
checkout.success.notFoundTitle: We could not verify the order
checkout.success.notFoundBody: The order does not exist or the link is no longer valid.
checkout.success.failedBody: Stripe did not confirm this payment. Go back to the checkout to try again.
order.placedSub: Your package is tracked in real time.
